Class UrlPathHelper

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.util.UrlPathHelper
public class UrlPathHelper extends Object
Helper class for URL path matching. Provides support for URL paths in RequestDispatcher includes and support for consistent URL decoding.

由 `AbstractUrlHandlerMapping` 和 `RequestContext` 用于路径匹配和/或 URI 确定。

Since:
14.01.2004
Author:
Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Rossen Stoyanchev
See Also:

  • Method Details

    • setAlwaysUseFullPath

      public void setAlwaysUseFullPath(boolean alwaysUseFullPath)
      Whether URL lookups should always use the full path within the current web application context, i.e. within ServletContext.getContextPath().

      如果设置为 false，则在适用的情况下（即在基于前缀的 Servlet 映射（如"/myServlet/*"）的情况下）使用当前 servlet 映射内的路径。

      默认情况下，该值设置为"false"。

    • setUrlDecode

      public void setUrlDecode(boolean urlDecode)
      Whether the context path and request URI should be decoded -- both of which are returned undecoded by the Servlet API, in contrast to the servlet path.

      当设置为"true"时，将使用请求编码或默认 Servlet 规范编码 (ISO-8859-1)。

      默认情况下，该值设置为 true。

      注意： 请注意，当与编码路径进行比较时，servlet 路径将不匹配。因此，使用 urlDecode=false 与基于前缀的 Servlet 映射不兼容，并且同样意味着需要设置 alwaysUseFullPath=true。

      See Also:
      • getServletPath(HttpServletRequest)
      • getContextPath(HttpServletRequest)
      • getRequestUri(HttpServletRequest)
      • WebUtils.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ENCODING
      • ServletRequest.getCharacterEncoding()

    • setDefaultEncoding

      public void setDefaultEncoding(String defaultEncoding)
      Set the default character encoding to use for URL decoding. Default is ISO-8859-1, according to the Servlet spec.

      如果请求本身指定了字符编码，则请求的编码将覆盖此设置。这也允许在调用 `ServletRequest.setCharacterEncoding` 方法的过滤器中通用地覆盖字符编码。

      Parameters:
      defaultEncoding - 要使用的字符编码
      See Also:
      • determineEncoding(HttpServletRequest)
      • ServletRequest.getCharacterEncoding()
      • ServletRequest.setCharacterEncoding(String)
      • WebUtils.DEFAULT_CHARACTER_ENCODING

    • getPathWithinServletMapping

      protected String getPathWithinServletMapping(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, String pathWithinApp)
      Return the path within the servlet mapping for the given request, i.e. the part of the request's URL beyond the part that called the servlet, or "" if the whole URL has been used to identify the servlet.

      如果在 RequestDispatcher 的 include 中调用，则检测包含请求的 URL。

      例如：servlet mapping = "/*"; request URI = "/test/a" → "/test/a"。

      例如：servlet 映射 = "/"；请求 URI = "/test/a" → "/test/a"。

      例如：servlet mapping = "/test/*"; request URI = "/test/a" → "/a"。

      例如：servlet mapping = "/test"; request URI = "/test" → ""。

      例如：servlet mapping = "/*.test"；request URI = "/a.test" → ""。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      pathWithinApp - 应用程序内的预计算路径
      Returns:
      servlet 映射中的路径，或""
      Since:
      5.2.9
      See Also:
      • getLookupPathForRequest(HttpServletRequest)

    • getRequestUri

      public String getRequestUri(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request)
      Return the request URI for the given request, detecting an include request URL if called within a RequestDispatcher include.

      由于 `request.getRequestURI()` 返回的值不会被 Servlet 容器解码，此方法将对其进行解码。

      Web 容器解析的 URI应该是正确的，但某些容器（如 JBoss/Jetty）会错误地在 URI 中包含类似";jsessionid"的字符串。此方法会截断此类不正确的附加内容。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前 HTTP 请求
      Returns:
      请求 URI

    • decodeRequestString

      public String decodeRequestString(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, String source)
      Decode the given source string with a URLDecoder. The encoding will be taken from the request, falling back to the default "ISO-8859-1".

      默认实现使用 `URLDecoder.decode(input, enc)`。

      Parameters:

      source - 要解码的字符串
      Returns:
      解码后的字符串
